heading: Short title
content:
1.
Short title
(1)
This Ordinance may be cited as the Buildings Ordinance.
(2)
This Ordinance shall apply to the New Territories in the manner provided by the Buildings Ordinance (Application to the New Territories) Ordinance (Cap. 121).
(Replaced 60 of 1987 s. 14)
